purpose: 展示既有比较提到的 version 帮助说明，保留两侧真实原文，不将措辞差异作为新增验收要求。
output:
usage: edgefleet heartbeat <submit|health|history> [flags]

commands:
  submit   receive heartbeats from stdin as a JSON array
  health   query node health from its latest telemetry
  history  list all heartbeats for a node, ascending by seq

input format (submit):
  A JSON array of heartbeat objects; every field is required.
    node          string   node id (non-empty)
    seq           integer  sequence number (> 0)
    collected_at  string   RFC3339 with timezone, e.g. 2026-10-01T12:00:00+08:00
                           must not be later than the receive time
    version       string   version (non-empty, valid Unicode text)
    height        integer  block height (>= 0)
    missed        integer  cumulative missed duties (>= 0)

  example:
    [{"node":"val-eu-1","seq":7,"collected_at":"2026-10-01T11:59:00+08:00",
      "version":"1.26.0","height":12345,"missed":0}]

flags:
  submit   --data-dir DIR        data directory (default: $EDGEFLEET_DATA_DIR or ~/.edgefleet)
           --receive-time TIME   receive time, RFC3339 (default: now)
  health   --node ID             node id (required)
           --expected-version V  expected version (required)
           --tolerated-misses N  tolerated missed duties, >= 0 (required)
           --missed-since-seq S  seq of a saved heartbeat used as the
                                missed-duty baseline (optional, > 0)
           --at TIME             query time, RFC3339 (default: now)
           --data-dir DIR        data directory

  Without --missed-since-seq the missed-duty alarm uses the cumulative
  missed count of the latest heartbeat (missed in the output). With it,
  the alarm counts only missed duties newly recorded between the baseline
  heartbeat seq S and the latest one; a count strictly greater than
  --tolerated-misses alarms, equality does not. The output then shows the
  baseline seq, the baseline cumulative count and the new count. If the
  cumulative counter decreased between the baseline and the latest record
  (e.g. after a node reset), the new count is shown as 无法判断 and a
  累计漏签数回退 finding is reported; the baseline must name an existing
  saved seq, otherwise the command fails.

  history  --node ID             node id (required)
           --data-dir DIR        data directory

data storage:
  <data-dir>/nodes/<hex-node-id>.json, one file per node.
  Writes are atomic and the directory is locked for concurrent access.
  Corrupt data is refused, never silently cleared.

purpose: 提交包含中文、表情和用户实际输入的替换字符的合法版本。
command: go run ./cmd/edgefleet heartbeat submit --data-dir fleet-data --receive-time 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z < reports.json

purpose: 用合法 Unicode 转义表示同一版本，观察真实新增数和重复数。
command: go run ./cmd/edgefleet heartbeat submit --data-dir fleet-data --receive-time 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z < retry.json

purpose: 观察保存后的准确版本文字和唯一历史记录。
command: go run ./cmd/edgefleet heartbeat history --data-dir fleet-data --node val-eu-1
output: node=val-eu-1 seq=7 collected_at=2026-10-01T11:59:00Z version=正式版-😀-� height=100 missed=0

purpose: 同批提交合法的新序号与第二条含未配对代理项的版本，观察真实错误及非零退出。
command: go run ./cmd/edgefleet heartbeat submit --data-dir fleet-data --receive-time 2026-10-01T12:00:00Z < pending.json
output:
error: invalid input: record 2: version contains an unpaired high surrogate \uD800
exit status 1
